source_checks: Every plan returns execution_enabled=false and cuda_enabled=false, including complete-looking manifests and explicit setup modes. No installer or subprocess/RSS backend exists.

The prepared CPU function raises unconditionally as its first statement, before imports or writes. Loading/calling it under fake tests never imports Torch; editing to a runnable derivative requires separate review.

The only simulated process/resource/clock inputs accepted are exact local fake types. Sample thresholds, free-memory checks, ownership refusal, nonzero exit, deadline expiry and cleanup failure are modeled without native operations.

The 120-second probe model reserves its last 10 seconds for cleanup and requires enough of the shared 30-minute preparation/probe budget. The overall 35-minute plan retains 5 minutes of cleanup reserve.
RSS is explicitly a sampled stop threshold rather than a proven hard cap. Windows process-tree containment, sampling, race-safe launch and cleanup remain unimplemented prerequisites.

CPU template uses random small built-in model initialization, no real tokenizer/base weights, rank 8 q/k/v/o adapters, two optimizer steps and target-only shifted-loss/frozen-base/adapter-gradient checks, followed by one local adapter save/reload comparison. All template body behavior remains unexecuted.
GPU execution stays disabled pending CUDA initialization/driver/workspace overhead policy and total-device sampling/stop rules. The 256 MiB tensor allocation proposal is not total VRAM containment.
The corrected manifest validator requires actual strings for closure and wheel hashes before 64-character hexadecimal checks. A 64-digit-integer regression now rejects both forged hash types.
Receipts preserve simulation and execution-disabled flags, finite failure reasons and numeric samples; no private paths, exception text, logs or credentials are included.
resolved_finding: Removed str() hash coercion and added one regression; total fake tests increased from 21 to 22.
required_before_real_execution: Complete reviewed wheel closure and actual local asset verification.
